GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th fence 4 Lengths 800m 4th 5 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 5th weakened final 200m # every ch/weak late

Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then shifted 3 Wide into the turn, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # never a threat

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced keenly well back on inside (7L from lead). Stayed well back on inside midrace & pushed to chase @ 450m. Chasing 3 Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 300m & gave ground Two Wide in last 200m. # Always struggling.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. Near the 1100m, was steadied when it improved onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, drifted straight back & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # never featured

Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to chase @ 550m. Struggling Two Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Hel up @ 250m & no ridden out in last 200m. Blinkers First Time # Always rearward.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped, and unbalanced, on two occasions shortly after the start. Momentarily eased from heels shortly after straightening. Approaching the 200m was checked severely after improving onto the heels of another runner as it shifted out slightly. Not tested for the remainder of the event when a beaten horse.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 3 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden when Headed soon after Straightening Up , weakened last 200m # tough run/brave
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Bumped near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide joint Lead settling down, in Two Wide at 900m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # no real excuses
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. battled on well # Every Chance

Bumped @ start. Raced keenly 3rd Two Wide (1.5L from lead) early . Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & gave ground in last 200m. # didn't finish off

Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it travelled comfortably early/middle stages, was left flat-footed when the leaders sprinted at 400m, was under immediate pressure and just ground its way to the line. He added it was not suited by the way the race was run and would be better suited over further ground and being able to work into a sprint. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding jockey stated that his mount travelled comfortably behind a moderate tempo in the early and middle stages. Jockey stated that when the leaders sprinted approaching the 400m his mount was left flat footed and was under immediate pressure. Jockey added that his mount just ground its way to the line. Jockey stated that his mount was not suited by the manner in which the race was run and he is of the opinion it would be better suited over a longer journey and being able to work into a sprint. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved back to 2nd place in Straight but a long way from the winner # winner far too good

Away fairly. Niggled early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & chasing Four Wide @ 400m. Pressured Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Outsprinted Six Wide in straight. # Never Likely
